Analytical by nature,
business-driven by choice

I'm Ishan a data analytics student based in Rotterdam, currently working as a Werkstudent Data Analist at DFDS Logistics in Vlaardingen. With a background in logistics coordination and operations management, I bring a rare combination: I understand how businesses actually run, and I know how to use data to make them run better.

From coordinating production lines at VanGelder to building Power BI dashboards at DFDS — I've always been the person asking: how do we make this more efficient? Now I'm building the technical toolkit to answer that question at scale.

This portfolio is a collection of real-world projects focused on Dutch market challenges — logistics, housing, energy, and labour. Not textbook exercises. Cases that matter.
